info.text:
Average pay is losing to prices, and Tuesday's report updates the score.
Average hourly pay rose 3.1% in the year to October; consumer prices rose 3.7% in the year to September (BLS).
October CPI comes out Tuesday, Nov 10, at 8:30 AM ET. Gas was up 34.2% in a year in September.
Wednesday, Nov 11 (Veterans Day): stocks open, bond market closed. Friday, Nov 13: wholesale prices (PPI), which rose 6.3% in the year to September, the most since 2022.
Sources: BLS CPI and PPI releases and schedules, SIFMA holiday schedule via Kiplinger.
News and education, not financial advice.
Follow @financeprostv for money explained simply.
